title: An idea about coastal oxygen variability
query: Drawing on the supplied related work and 2018–2022 CMOMS data for the supplied northern South China Sea coastal domain, develop and investigate a research idea about oxygen variability or hypoxia.

data_scope.region: northern South China Sea shelf/slope and supplied coastal masks
data_scope.depth: all available fixed physical depth levels
data_scope.geometry: Coordinates, physical depth/bathymetry, cell areas, wet/land masks and velocity collocation/orientation. Same per-year/per-variable layout as B1; new years must be provided.
data_scope.limits: No nutrient, sediment, respiration, PAR, turbidity or river-discharge fields are assumed. Five years permit cross-year checks where supported; do not infer causal budget closure from the six fields.

related_work.title: Spatiotemporal Development and Dissipation of Hypoxia Induced by Variable Wind-Driven Shelf Circulation off the Pearl River Estuary: Observational and Modeling Studies
related_work.source_dataset: Pearl River Estuary/coastal transition zone; field observations and ROMS physical-biological process experiments.

related_work.title: Sediment Legacy Organic Matter Amplifies Nutrient-Driven Coastal Hypoxia: A Coupled Benthic-Pelagic Modeling Study
related_work.source_dataset: Pearl River Estuary ROMS physical-biogeochemical model building on Li2021; new sediment module;45-day idealized summer experiments and2017/2021 field constraints.

reading_policy: Supply the same frozen full texts to both agents before running. Bibliographic records and abstracts alone are not the full reading pack. Extra literature retrieval follows the same logged policy. Evaluator checklists and selection rationales are not handed to agents.
reading_data_alignment: Same estuary and explicitly linked model lineage, but different process experiments; neither is proven identical to the historical CMOMS archive. This is the least exact data match and remains provisional.
